packageRules.description: Group Go module updates so a week of patch bumps is one review, not ten.
The Go toolchain floor is set by dependencies, not by preference. Raising it changes the pinned build images too, so it gets its own review.
shadcn-svelte components are copied into the tree, not installed; bits-ui and friends are their runtime and should move together.
Docker base images move on their own cadence.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
